subject: Guidance on minimum monthly commit + formal rate card request
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenroutes.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API - minimum commit options & rate card (follow-up)

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet last week. Per our discussion I wanted to share the hosted-API commit options we typically offer for early production customers and attach the latest rate card for reference. Quick recap below so you have a single place to share with your finance/procurement team.

Attached: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-v2.pdf (summary + line items)

Baseline (no commit)
- On-demand billing: standard list rates (pay-as-you-go). No minimum monthly spend.

Pilot-friendly commit (3-month pilot)
- $2,000/month committed spend (3 months) — ~10% effective discount vs list on token units during the pilot window.
- Rollover: unused committed dollars do not roll beyond the 3-month pilot, but we can convert any unused pilot credit into first-month credit if you convert to an annual commit.

Standard monthly commits (monthly billed, auto-renew / cancellable with 30d notice)
- $5,000/month commit -> 10% off list token rates
- $25,000/month commit -> 20% off list token rates + priority support tier
- $75,000+/month commit -> 30% off list rates + SLA uplift and single-tenant routing options (still hosted)

Annual reserved commitments (preferred pricing)
- Annual prepay option for 10–20% additional savings depending on term length; invoiced upfront or quarterly.

Overages and throttling
- Overages above committed spend are billed monthly at list rates minus the commit discount. We also offer burst protection policies for predictable spiky workloads; Jordan can recommend settings based on your QPS.

Clarifying notes
- Hosted API commitments do not require Dedicated capacity to start; they simply convert committed spend into a discount and support level.
- Price lock window: we can hold quoted commit pricing for 45 days from the date of this email.
- Billing: Net30 for invoiced deals, PO-friendly.

A couple of asks so we can put together an official quote/SOW:
1) Estimated average tokens/month and any expected monthly peaks (tokens or QPS).
2) Desired commit tier (pilot, $5k, $25k, $75k+), or whether you prefer an annual prepay.
3) Procurement timeline (PO within 30/60/90 days?).

If it helps I can propose a short mutual action plan and send a PO-ready invoice once you confirm the tier. Jordan — feel free to add any technical constraints you want me to include.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

--
Attachment: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-v2.pdf (11 pages, pricing summary + SKU table)

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the attachment — appreciated. A few quick answers and questions from our side:

- Usage: for an initial launch we estimate ~100M tokens/month (prompt+completion) with short bursts up to ~250M in peak months. Embeddings volume expected to be small initially (~50k requests).
- Pilot appetite: we'd like to run a 2–3 month pilot but $2k/mo feels low relative to our expected ramp; would you consider a $10k 3-month pilot with the ability to convert any unused portion into the annual prepay if we go that route?
- Rollover/refund: can unused committed dollars be rolled forward or refunded if we fail to hit commit?
- Can you provide a PO-ready quote with tax ID and invoicing address so our procurement team can review?

If you can share an SOW template and a short mutual action plan with milestones (PO, integration, production cutover), that will expedite approval.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of ML Products | GreenRoutes AI
alyssa@greenroutes.ai

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API - minimum commit options & rate card (follow-up)

Thanks Alyssa — great context. We can absolutely structure a pilot for $10k over 3 months (i.e., $3,333/mo effective) with the following guardrails:

- Pilot structure: $10,000 total commitment, applied as credits over a 90-day pilot window.
- Conversion: If GreenRoutes converts to an annual commit within the pilot window, any unused pilot credit will be applied pro-rata to the first invoice for the annual term.
- Rollover: by default pilot credits do not roll beyond conversion; for standard monthly commits (non-pilot) we can include a 1-month roll-forward of unused committed dollars upon request (we'll note this in the SOW).
- Refunds: we do not typically offer cash refunds for committed promotional credits; conversion to an annual plan or credit toward subsequent invoices is the standard path.

I've attached an editable SOW template (SOW-Redwood-GreenRoutes-template.docx) and a short mutual action plan below. Jordan, please review the burst protection settings I recommend at the bottom. Grace, I've cc'd you for invoicing/tax info so we can produce a PO-ready document.

Mutual action plan (proposed)
1) Confirm pilot commitment and sign SOW (target: this week)
2) Prod API integration & test (2 weeks)
3) Pilot monitoring & cost controls (weeks 3–10)
4) Conversion decision & annual pricing (by day 90)

Burst protection / throttling recommendations (Jordan)
- Set per-route QPS limits and token caps to avoid surprise overages; allow short bursts up to 2x baseline for 5–10 minutes during traffic spikes.
- Enable prefix caching for common prompts to reduce token spend.

I will prepare a PO-ready quote and lock the price for 45 days after I send it. If you confirm the $10k pilot, I'll attach the formal invoice and SOW.

Best,
Sergio
